hooks.name: Pre-PR self check
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, remind it to verify the work with real output and hand the diff to a fresh review.

action.prompt: If you changed code this turn, follow reviewers/pre-pr-self-check.md: run the repo's tests, lint and build and show the real output, then review only the diff in a fresh context. If you changed nothing, do nothing.
